newsitem.title: USA: Bionx patent upheld by European authority.
newsitem.headline: Bionx patent upheld by European authority.

text.p: Bionx Implants Inc said Monday the European Patent Office has upheld its patent describing the self-reinforcing techniques used to make Bionx implants.
The company said at issue was the European counterpart to its U.S. patent. All claims in the European patent were upheld, it said.

In a statement, Bionx Implants President and CEO David Anderson said, "This affirmation...of the strength of the Bionx intellectual property confirms our confidence in the groundbreaking work performed by our research group."
